architecture.model: Exactly one event instance per contract account; that instance issues many nontransferable account-bound passes (max 200 active, one active registration per account).
architecture.organizer: Immutable constructor argument stored in Config. publish_event requires predecessor == config.organizer before any other check or write, preventing first-publish front-running.
architecture.one_event_enforcement: publish_event requires next_event_seq == 0 before validation, native-credit insertion or event insertion; any second publish of any event id traps with 'event already published' and changes no state, credit or escrow.
architecture.pass_identity: External key tuple is (network, contract account, pass_id). pass_id is unique within the contract; owner = participant = beneficiary; no transfer/approval/burn/admin-reassignment.
architecture.factory_scope: Permissionless child-contract factory/registry is not implemented and is explicitly out of this slice.
architecture.compatibility_views: The bounded list/get views remain in place; list_events returns zero or one event. get_event(event_id), list_event_registrations(event_id, from, limit) are unchanged for this first instance.

write_methods.storage_deposit: storage_deposit(account_id?) payable in native NEAR; charges measured new-entry growth first, credits remainder only, rejects too-small new prepay atomically; existing top-up is full
write_methods.publish_event: publish_event(event_id, rules) payable; only config.organizer; exactly one event for contract lifetime; attached deposit pays credit-entry growth then measured event growth
write_methods.ft_on_transfer: ft_on_transfer(sender_id, amount, msg) only canonical FT; bounded versioned message {version:1,event_id,commitment_id}; exact D; one registration + one account-bound pass in one receipt or full resolver refund

panic_guards: only the configured organizer may publish
storage deposit too small for new credit entry: attached {amount}, requires {entry_cost}
event_id must be 1..=64 safe ASCII chars
rules_hash must be 1..=128 printable ASCII chars
abi_review.event_ids_and_pass_ids: event_id is organizer-supplied and validated; pass_id = pass-{next_registration_seq}, unique per contract instance

blocker_fix.problem: add_credit credited the full attached deposit and did not charge the native storage growth of a new credits entry; publish_event called add_credit before its storage measurement, so the same new entry was uncharged and a 1 yoctoNEAR deposit could make the contract pay for persistent storage.
fix: add_credit measures env::storage_usage() across its own tentative credits insert and charges that actual growth from the attached amount.
A new entry receives only attached-minus-entry-cost credit; an attached amount below the measured entry cost restores the previous value (or removes the new key) and traps atomically.
An existing credits entry is a fixed-size Borsh u128, so top-ups are charged only actual growth (measured zero) and are credited in full.
publish_event charges its credit entry first and then measures event growth after that entry already exists.
storage_deposit returns and logs the net charged balance, plus storage_charge_yocto and credited_yocto; FT principal remains separate.
unchanged_invariants: immutable canonical FT, network and policy version
owner = participant = beneficiary for pass and registration
no transfer, approval, burn or admin reassignment
exact canonical-FT deposit D; every invalid ft_on_transfer path returns the full amount with no state
